text:
incident-bot: [P0] realtime /generate error spike in us-west-2 — rolling 5m error rate 12% (baseline ~0.4%). Affected model variant: orca-lite-experimental-v2-quant. Suspect: recent kernel optimization + quant path. Auto-mitigation suggestion: mute variant and shift traffic to orca-lite-stable-v2. Paging Sam (on-call).

Sam: taking it. pinging PD and grabbing logs. @pagerduty are you on the call? :phone:

pagerduty: Pager duty escalation triggered — Sam is assigned. Incident conference link: https://meet.example/inc/2177777777

Sam: quick check — top errors are 502/503 + inference timeouts. tail of runtime logs shows repeated "KV cache mismatch" on orca-lite-experimental-v2-quant.

Ashley: I can run the traffic switch. Recommending immediate 0% weight on experimental variant and route to stable. Command:```bash
rwdctl routing set-weight --model orca-lite-experimental-v2-quant --weight 0 --policy immediate
rwdctl routing set-weight --model orca-lite-stable-v2 --weight +100 --policy immediate
```

infra-bot: executing: rwdctl routing set-weight --model orca-lite-experimental-v2-quant --weight 0 --policy immediate
infra-bot: ✅ OK — change propagated to control plane (5 nodes reporting).

Ashley: also applying per-key emergency quota for heavy customers to avoid thundering herd while we observe:```bash
rwdctl quotas update --scope customer:acme-corp --max-tokens-per-minute 200
rwdctl quotas update --scope customer:betaapps --max-tokens-per-minute 100
```

Maria: compiling affected customer list — preliminary: Acme (chat product), BetaApps (search), 2 smaller mobile bots. Not seeing major revenue-tier hits yet but risk there. Reached out to Acme CSM and sent templated note.

Sam: throwing escalation to ProductOps for status comms. Lee — can you take handoff and own mitigation validation for the next hour? I'm going to run postmortem kickoff and capture timeline.

Lee: taking it. Oncall shift acknowledged. I'll validate output quality on stable variant and check latency P95. Can you drop the smoke test?

Sam: running smoke:```bash
# smoke requests against /generate using stable variant
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate -d '{"model":"orca-lite-stable-v2","prompt":"Write a short haiku about rain"}' | jq .
```

Sam: smoke responded in 120ms, content looks fine. p95 latency on stable jumped +10ms but within SLO. Error rate back to baseline after routing change (5m error rate 0.6%).

Lee: verifying traces — no KV mismatch errors on stable. Rolling logs show experimental variant still failing when any traffic tries to reach it (good to have it offline).

ProductOps: drafting status for impacted customers — will send a 'mitigating' update mentioning temporary removal of experimental variant and that a rollback/patch is in progress.

Ashley: recording the exact command and ticket: CL-9876 (routing rollback), created internal flag: mitigation:mute-orca-lite-exp-v2-quant.

infra-bot: Note: I triggered a soft-circuit on hostpool us-west-2-pool-3 to reduce retry storm while control-plane routes converge.

Maria: Acme CSM replied — appreciate quick response, asked if rate limits will be lifted when resolved. I told them we'll evaluate and follow up.

Lee: monitoring metrics: 30m window shows stable variant handling increased load with acceptable latencies. QPS increased by ~18% on stable, CPU on stable hosts at 72% — room to scale if needed.

Sam: next steps: 1) keep experimental variant muted 2) triage root cause with research team (kernel/quantization) 3) prepare canary with the previous working commit or force-use of non-quant path for a test rollout 4) customer comms + RCA timeline.

Ashley: I'm spinning up a canary of orca-lite-experimental-v2 with quant disabled (build tag: no-quant-202603) to validate. Will only allow 1% traffic if healthy. Command:```bash
rwdctl deploy canary --model orca-lite-experimental-v2-quant --image orca-lite:no-quant-202603 --traffic 1% --policy gradual --max-errors 0.5%
```

infra-bot: Canary deployed to us-west-2 small pool. Health checks passing. Observing for 10 minutes.

Lee: handing off monitoring to Ashley for canary. I'll stay on until the next rotation to finalize rollback decision. Sam, if you need me to reassign pager let me know.

Sam: thanks — I'll start postmortem doc and link logs. Immediate mitigation successful; marking incident as 'mitigated' for customer impact but P1 remains open for RCA.

ProductOps: posted initial status update to customers indicating mitigation and next steps.

Maria: closed loop with Acme — they asked for ETA on full fix. Told them we'll update within 6 hours after triage.

Ashley: canary currently stable for 12 minutes, no KV errors observed. If it stays green for 30m we'll consider a cautious phased re-enable with extra quotas throttled.

Sam: end-of-thread handoff note: incident state = mitigated (traffic moved). Owner for RCA = Research (assigned: Maria + ML infra). Handoff to Lee for monitoring and recovery window. Please add timeline entries to CL-9876.

infra-bot: Incident log appended: mitigation=mute-variant; routed_to=orca-lite-stable-v2; tickets=[CL-9876]; canary=no-quant-202603.

Sam: thanks all. Postmortem will include timeline, root cause hypotheses (quant kernel regression), rollback plan, and customer comms template. :white_check_mark:

Lee: leaving monitoring for next hour, will post follow-up in this thread.

Ashley: queued follow-up for 30m to either ramp canary or proceed to full rollback depending on results.

ProductOps: adding a short note in the incident doc for CS to reuse: "We temporarily removed the experimental model variant after error spikes; traffic was routed to the stable variant; mitigation in place and engineers are working on a permanent fix."

Sam: closing active pager now but will keep thread open for RCA notes. Great job team. :trophy:
